customer: Caller from Eastvale, annoyed, says he can't find the title for his full-size SUV and is worried it'll hold up trading it in for a bigger vehicle.
agent: Customer asked how to replace a lost title before his trade-in appointment. Explained from 'Getting a duplicate title in Eastvale' that he can apply for a duplicate at any Eastvale motor vehicle office with his photo ID and registration, and that main offices print duplicates the same day, while by mail it takes 2 to 3 weeks. Reminded him to bring the duplicate to his appointment.
